text: Considered reusing Ticket or VerifiedBy to carry the contradicted contract reference rather than adding a field. Rejected both: Ticket means a tracker reference and would become indistinguishable from one, and VerifiedBy holds checks asserted to verify the claim, so putting the contradicted contract there inverts the field's meaning. Added a dedicated 'contradicts' field instead, which also makes the schema_version bump substantive rather than ceremonial.
